description: Compliance limits what these guests can say about positions and clients, so aim at process, calibration, and incentives. Never ask for a call on a specific security - it can be a regulatory problem rather than merely an awkward one.

questions.text: How do you tell the difference between being wrong and being early?
questions.lands_because: The defining epistemics of the job, and a question anyone who takes risk has genuinely wrestled with. It gets past compliance because it is about method, not positioning.
followups: What is your actual rule for cutting a losing position?

questions.text: What does your model not capture, and how do you account for that?
questions.lands_because: Every quantitative professional knows the boundary of their model, and describing it is the most honest form of expertise they can offer publicly.
followups: When did that gap last cost you?

questions.text: Who bears the risk when you are wrong - you, the firm, or the client?
questions.lands_because: Goes directly at the asymmetry that defines the industry's reputation, framed structurally so it can be answered without self-indictment.

questions.text: What is the most consequential thing you have to explain to clients that they consistently do not want to believe?
questions.lands_because: Works for advisors, underwriters, and adjusters alike, and produces practical value for the audience without touching a specific recommendation.
followups: What actually gets through to them?

questions.text: What behavior does your compensation structure produce that nobody would defend in the abstract?
questions.lands_because: Everyone in finance has an answer - quarter-end behavior, gathering assets over serving them, volume over quality - and the abstract framing makes it safe to give.
followups: Has anyone tried to fix it?
questions.avoid_if: The guest currently sets compensation policy at a named firm.

questions.text: What did 2008, or the closest equivalent in your corner of the industry, actually teach you - as opposed to what everyone says it taught them?
questions.lands_because: The clause rejecting the received lesson is what makes it work. It forces past the rehearsed narrative into what the guest personally changed.
followups: What do you do differently now, concretely?
